source_evidence.counter: AssemblyRenderer57–64 entries.forEachIndexed; decode/draw only if destination width and height >0; progress(index+1,entries.size) occurs after branch for each processed entry. Thus completed-entry count, not ongoing operation count or necessarily images rendered.
source_evidence.ICO: IcoCodec38–50 selects internal entry, creates dimensions from selected.width/height, extracts PNG and compares ImportedImage.dimensions != source. Error is corresponding entry declaration mismatch, not path/folder mismatch.

decision: No safe complete corrections authored from currently available evidence. Preserve holds rather than superficial tense edits, script conversions or inserted technical fragments.
